name: freelancer-deals-mcp
description: Freelancer (deals): me, search_postings, get_posting, submit_bid, withdraw_bid, bid_status, list_mes

platform_mcp_freelancer_access_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_FREELANCER_ACCESS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_freelancer_access_token.description: Freelancer OAuth access token sent as the freelancer-oauth-v1 header: a Personal Access Token from https://accounts.freelancer.com/settings/develop ('valid for thirty days') or a token from your registered OAuth app (scopes basic, fln:project_manage, fln:messaging, fln:user_information as needed).

platform_mcp_freelancer_bidder_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_FREELANCER_BIDDER_ID
platform_mcp_freelancer_bidder_id.description: Your Freelancer user id (GET /users/0.1/self/ → result.id); required by POST /projects/0.1/bids/ as bidder_id.

platform_mcp_freelancer_milestone_percen.title: PLATFORM_MCP_FREELANCER_MILESTONE_PERCENTAGE
platform_mcp_freelancer_milestone_percen.description: Initial milestone percentage (20–100) required by POST /projects/0.1/bids/ ('Please fill in the milestone percentage (20 - 100)').

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /users/0.1/self/ (scopes basic, fln:user_information); result.id is the bidder_id submit_bid needs.

tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: GET /projects/0.1/projects/active/ (scope basic): query = space-separated terms over names and descriptions; min_price filters fixed-price budgets ≥ the value in USD; limit/offset page. Categories are numeric job ids (jobs[]), so category is not sent. owner_id, time_submitted (Unix), seo_url, bid_stats and jobs stay in raw.

tools.name: submit_bid
tools.description: POST /projects/0.1/bids/ (scopes basic, fln:project_manage) with {project_id, bidder_id, amount, period, milestone_percentage, description}; 'Required fields: project_id, bidder_id, amount, period, milestone_percentage'. bidder_id and milestone_percentage come from config fields; amount is in the project's currency (currency is not sent). 409 DUPLICATE_BID if you already bid. Automatic bidding is a prohibited integration — one explicit bid per call.

tools.name: withdraw_bid
tools.description: PUT /projects/0.1/bids/{bid_id}/ with form action=retract ('retracts the bid from the project before it has been awarded').

tools.name: bid_status
tools.description: GET /projects/0.1/bids/{bid_id}/; status is award_status (awarded, rejected, revoked, pending, canceled — the schema allows null); retracted, paid_status and complete_status stay in raw.

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: GET /messages/0.1/messages/ (scope fln:messaging) filtered by threads[]=thread_id. from_user is a numeric user id and time_created Unix time; both stay in raw.
